summary.text: Zack Dunn is the Democratic candidate for Texas House of Representatives District 121 in the November 3, 2026, general election, running against Republican incumbent Marc LaHood.
Dunn has worked as a special victims unit prosecutor in the Bexar County District Attorney's Office.

paragraphs.text: Dunn was born in Belleville, Illinois, and graduated from Ronald Reagan High School.
Dunn earned a bachelor's degree from the University of Texas at San Antonio and a law degree from the University of Pennsylvania Law School.
Dunn advanced from the Democratic primary on March 3, 2026, receiving 15,791 votes as the only Democrat on the ballot.
